name: multiverse
description: MULTIVERSE — Financial Parallel Universe Engine (monorepo root).

scripts.check: npm run check:py && npm run check:ts && npm run contracts:check && npm run check:web
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run lint-imports && uv run pytest
scripts.check:ts: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts
scripts.check:web: npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.test: uv run pytest && npm run test:ts
scripts.contracts:gen: uv run python -m multiverse_contracts.export && npm run gen --workspace @multiverse/contracts
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python -m multiverse_contracts.export --check && npm run gen:check --workspace @multiverse/contracts
